# [TASK] Add stale-Dependabot-PR auto-close workflow

## Task

Dependabot is already configured (`.github/dependabot.yml`) and OpenRewrite is already wired in `build.gradle`. The only missing piece is automatic closure of stale Dependabot PRs that CI rejects or that age out without a merge, so the PR list stays clean.

## Scope

Add `.github/workflows/dependabot-auto-close.yml`: a scheduled workflow (nightly or twice-weekly) that closes any open Dependabot PR older than 14 days whose CI checks have not all passed. Include a comment on the closed PR explaining the reason, so it's auditable.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The workflow file exists and triggers on schedule.
- [ ] A test run (manual `workflow_dispatch`) closes a Dependabot PR older than 14 days with a stale comment and leaves newer ones untouched.
- [ ] No non-Dependabot PRs are affected.

## Estimate

**Hours:** 1

## Notes

Dependabot is already configured for Gradle, npm (filmpire frontend), GitHub Actions, and Docker on a weekly/monthly cadence. OpenRewrite Spring Boot 4.0 recipes are already active in `build.gradle`. No new tooling is needed — only the stale-PR cleanup workflow.
